english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for allowing someone to do something.

exampleSentences.english: Mum agrees to let us go out and play.
exampleSentences.jyutping: maa1 maa1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 ceot1 heoi3 waan2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for giving permission or giving someone something they have asked for.

exampleSentences.english: The boss finally agreed to grant me leave.
exampleSentences.jyutping: lou5 baan2 zung1 jyu1 bei2 ngo5 fong3 gaa3 laa3

english.note: Use 畀 as the everyday all-purpose verb when a person or authority lets something happen.

exampleSentences.english: I permit you to use my computer.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 nei5 jung6 ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5
